title: skip
description: Result of `stride skip <id> "<reason>" [activity|none]`. The substitute keys appear only when a link was made, released or stolen.

substitute_activity_id.description: The activity done in place of this session — the same key `plan.json` and `week.json` carry for the same concept. Until v3 this was spelled without `_id`, the payload being the outlier; the v2 schema recorded that retiring the second spelling belonged behind an envelope bump, and v3 was that bump.
